export interface AnyMessage {
    readonly template: string;
    readonly config: MessageConfig;
}
export type ArgsFor<P extends readonly Placeholder[], C, E extends EngineTypes> = {
    readonly [H in P[number] as H['name']]: ArgFor<H, C, E>;
};
export type ArgsOf<App, K> = ParamsOf<MessageAt<App, K>>;
export type ArgumentFreeKey<App> = {
    [K in MessageKey<App>]: keyof ArgsOf<App, K> extends never ? K : never;
}[MessageKey<App>];
export type Branches = {
    readonly [Category in Intl.LDMLPluralRule]?: string;
} & {
    readonly other: string;
    readonly formatter?: EntryOf<'number'>;
    readonly type?: Intl.PluralRuleType;
};
export interface CatalogueSet<App> {
    readonly locale: string;
    readonly source: App;
    readonly translations: {
        readonly [locale: string]: Translation<App>;
    };
}
export type CatalogueShape = {
    readonly [namespace: string]: {
        readonly [name: string]: AnyMessage;
    };
};
export const Catalogues: Token<LooseCatalogueSet>
export type CheckConfig<C, P extends readonly Placeholder[], E extends EngineTypes> = {
    readonly [K in keyof C]: K extends KindsIn<P> ? {
        readonly [N in keyof C[K]]: N extends NamesOf<P, K> ? CheckEntry<C[K][N], E, K> : Fails<UnknownParam<N & string>>;
    } : Fails<UnknownKind<K & string>>;
};
export type ClashingKinds<Name extends string> = `ClashingKinds<'${Name}'>`;
export type ConfigFor<P extends readonly Placeholder[], E extends EngineTypes> = Flatten<{
    readonly [K in RequiredKinds<P, E>]: {
        readonly [N in NamesOf<P, K>]: EntryFor<E, K>;
    };
} & {
    readonly [K in Exclude<KindsIn<P>, RequiredKinds<P, E>>]?: {
        readonly [N in NamesOf<P, K>]?: EntryFor<E, K>;
    };
}>;
export type ConfigKey = string & {
    readonly [configKey]: true;
};
export type DisjointNamespaces<Parts extends readonly CatalogueShape[], Merged = unknown> = Parts extends readonly [
    infer Head,
    ...infer Rest extends readonly CatalogueShape[]
] ? [
    keyof Head & keyof Merged
] extends [
    never
] ? DisjointNamespaces<Rest, Merged & Head> : NamespaceCollision<keyof Head & keyof Merged & string> : Flatten<Merged>;
export type DuplicateParam<Name extends string> = `DuplicateParam<'${Name}'>`;
export interface Engine<E extends EngineTypes> {
    dt<const T extends string>(template: Unconfigured<T, E>): Bare<T, E>;
    dt<const T extends string, const C extends MessageConfig>(template: Template<T, E>, config: ConfigArg<T, C, E>): Configured<T, C, E>;
    defineCatalogue<Source extends CatalogueShape>(): (translation: Translation<Source>) => Translation<Source>;
    createI18n<App extends CatalogueShape>(): I18n<App>;
}
export interface EngineOf<Kinds extends readonly MessageKind[], Presets extends PresetTable, Params extends readonly string[]> {

export type IsCamelCase<S extends string> = S extends `${infer Head}${infer Rest}` ? Head extends Lower ? LettersOnly<Rest> : false : false;

export type MessageConfig = Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>>;
export type MessageFailure = FormatFailure | MissingMessage;
export type MessageKey<App> = {

export type ParamsOf<M> = M extends {

export type ParseTemplate<T extends string> = T extends `${string}{${infer Token}}${infer Rest}` ? [

export type PresetsFor<Presets, Kinds extends readonly MessageKind[]> = {
    readonly [K in keyof Presets]: K extends Kinds[number]['name'] ? {
        readonly [N in keyof Presets[K]]: {

                readonly name: K;

export type Translation<Source> = {

    };

export interface Translator<App> {
    t<K extends MessageKey<App>>(key: K, ...args: ArgsTuple<App, K>): Result<string, MessageFailure>;
    parts<K extends MessageKey<App>>(key: K, ...args: ArgsTuple<App, K>): Result<readonly MessagePart[], MessageFailure>;

    partsOr<K extends MessageKey<App>>(key: K, args: ArgsOf<App, K>, fallback: readonly MessagePart[]): readonly MessagePart[];
}
